title: Sapa in 4 days
summary: The night train from Hanoi, the stone church and Cat Cat, and Fansipan if the ridge is clear.

days.title: Day 1 — Night train
days.body: Leave Hanoi for Sa Pa and sleep on the train.

days.title: Day 2 — Church and Cat Cat
days.body: Spend about 60 minutes at the stone church, then walk to Cat Cat. The walk length is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 3 — Fansipan
days.body: Ride the cable car to Fansipan when the ridge is clear. The ride is given as about 15 minutes, as 15–20 minutes, and as 30 minutes.

days.title: Day 4 — Back to Hanoi
days.body: Return to Hanoi and keep the evening free.

seoDescription: A Sa Pa trip from Hanoi: the night train, the stone church, Cat Cat, and Fansipan.
